smoke_runs.interpretation: The board was still running an older runner image that ignored --syscall-side-channel.
The first temporary runner used PTRACE_GETREGS; the 35T RISC-V Linux target returned EIO.
PTRACE_GETREGSET produced board UART syscall side-channel rows, but this smoke used the pre state-machine-fix runner, so entry/return pairing was still misaligned.
After rebooting the 35T board through the LiteX serial image path with the updated rootfs, the smoke captured fd/path and process-tree side-channel evidence for the two targeted samples.
